title: Entity relationship sections
responsibility: Arranges resolved relations into users and categorized dependencies for display.

inputs.name: entityUsage.relations
inputs.description: Host-derived pages, consumers, categorized dependencies and support units.

inputs.name: usageGroups.items
inputs.description: Resolved revision-scoped consumers with declared module categories.

inputs.name: usageOwners.entities
inputs.description: Already resolved collection owners used when no full revision is supplied.

inputs.name: usageOwners.revision
inputs.description: Selected source revision containing active private and public runtime owners.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.helper
inputs.description: One callable with source-derived runtime consumer references.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.owners
inputs.description: Revision-scoped active owner projections, independent of public catalog admission.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.ownerId
inputs.description: Actual owner unit identifier used to exclude the callable itself.

inputs.name: usageIdentity.entity
inputs.description: Resolved consumer with optional recorded caller symbol.

outputs.name: entityUsage
outputs.description: Deduplicated users, nonempty consumer and dependency groups with icons, support units and total dependency count.

outputs.name: usageGroups
outputs.description: Nonempty navigation-ordered groups with distinct entity identifiers within each category.

outputs.name: usageOwners
outputs.description: Active runtime owners; unsupported owners open source without an invented entity page.

outputs.name: helperConsumers
outputs.description: Distinct active owner/callable consumers, excluding missing owners and true self references.

outputs.name: usageIdentity
outputs.description: Actual unit identity plus callable identity when recorded.
